metaDescription: Mudi vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Mudi boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Mudi owners tracking 13-14 years lifespans still lose the mid-series booster more often than the first shot, and the unprotected gap after week 8 is where parvovirus risk concentrates for this puppy.
Use the 4-row Mudi schedule as your only planning spine: 8 weeks (DA2PP / DHPP); 12 weeks (DA2PP / DHPP booster); 16 weeks (DA2PP / DHPP booster); 16 weeks (Rabies).
Temperament note for Mudi handling: Hungarian herder; rare breed epilepsy notes exist.. Schedule quieter appointment slots if that profile makes clinic visits harder, but do not skip the Mudi dose.
Lifestyle add-ons stay off this Mudi core list until your veterinarian maps exposure, so keep core dates sacred either way.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Owners postpone Mudi shots when the puppy seems “a little off,” travel intervenes, or hip dysplasia worries dominate the week — ask the clinic whether a same-week Mudi make-up is still appropriate instead of sliding to the annual exam.
Long gaps can leave Mudi antibody levels uncertain, so expect either an added booster or a titer conversation rather than a shrug.
Do not trade the missed Mudi dose for extra socialization; finish immunity first for this medium dog.
Reset the Mudi reminder stack the evening of the make-up appointment — including the eventual adult booster after the 16-week finish.

faqs.question: When does the Mudi core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Mudi misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Mudi health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Mudi adult health guide for breed predispositions such as hip dysplasia, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
